location.description: android://[serial][/path]: the device to restore to and the device directory to restore into (defaults to a new plakar-restore-<timestamp> directory at the top of the shared storage)

serial.description: adb serial of the device, as shown by 'adb devices'; same as putting it in the location

destination_path.description: Absolute device directory to restore into; overrides the path in the location

overwrite.description: Replace files that already exist on the device with different content; by default they are reported as errors

allow_any_path.description: Allow a destination outside the shared storage (/storage, /sdcard, /data/local/tmp)

adb_server.description: host:port of the adb server (default 127.0.0.1:5037, or ANDROID_ADB_SERVER_PORT)

start_server.description: Run 'adb start-server' when no adb server answers on a local address

streams.description: Number of parallel file transfers over the adb link
